title.narrative: Furthering the Decent Work Agenda in the sub-region.

description.narrative: This CPO will support the implementation of the EECA Action Plan 2023-2025 (ENTERPRISES) for promoting Enterprise Development, Green Jobs, and a Just Transition in Europe and Central Asia, particularly targeting the constituents in Western and Central Asia. Also, ILO will support the preparation of members states for the COP29 to be held in Baku, Azerbaijan in November 2024. and for the COP30 to be held in Brazil in 2025. Support to UNCTs and UNRCs at country level for climate action and the NDCs preparation will be articulated through the Issue Based Coalition on Environment and Climate Change in Europe and Central Asia.
